text: The plumbing sandbox has Python 3 as well as git (#304). Its recipe adds python3=3.14.10-r1 from the pinned Go image's own Alpine release, because discovering Python components parses their source with Python's standard library, and a plumbing build's tests run in this sandbox. A build can't add a tool to the sandbox it runs in, so this change was built by hand. The sandbox still runs with no network; only building its image needs one.
